preconditions: Construction registers ClientManager listener; chat identity comes from replyTo. CCPM requires TLS availability, peer CCPM+TLS support and a suitable online hub.
defaults: ccpmAttempts=0; allowAutoCCPM=true; lastCCPMAttempt=0; ccpmState defaults DISCONNECTED unless initConnectState sees a supplied UserConnection, in which case it sets CONNECTED. `online` is initialized from `aUser.user->isOnline()` (the header initializer `true` is overridden by the constructor). Delay event tags are USER_UPDATE, CCPM_TIMEOUT, CCPM_AUTO. PMInfo values map MSG_SEEN, TYPING_ON, TYPING_OFF, NO_AUTOCONNECT, QUIT followed by sentinel PMINFO_LAST.
effects: The chat holds MessageCache initialized with PM_MESSAGE_CACHE and the hinted peer; ctor initializes `online` from User::isOnline, sets CONNECTED and registers the supplied connection when non-null, otherwise remains DISCONNECTED and schedules CCPM_AUTO after one second; it then registers ClientManager listener, reads history and checks ignored state. On online update it refreshes hint/hub, reports online, emits UserUpdated, and may schedule automatic CCPM after three seconds. Went-offline callback removes pending user update, clears connecting timeout, closes CCPM immediately, resets auto/online state, emits UserUpdated and offline status. A hub-only disconnect schedules a one-second update before checking current hub and emitting UserUpdated. Timeout reports warning, sets DISCONNECTED, and emits CCPMStatusUpdated if still CONNECTING. Automatic CCPM attempts only when ALWAYS_CCPM and allowCCPM; it caps retries at three and ready state resets the flag. checkIgnored posts an ignored-user status message; getToken reads reply user CID, getClient resolves current hint, getLogPath derives peer log path. CCPM state string maps the three enum states to localized status text.
events: UserUpdated is emitted after peer/hub state update or hub reevaluation; CCPMStatusUpdated occurs on timeout/state transition; status messages report online/offline/ignored/blocking states.
errors: No error result from getters or delayed callbacks. Connection errors are handled by the separate startCC/send flow contract.
behavior.completion: Client event callbacks are synchronous; delayed retry/timeout/user-refresh work executes later through DelayedEvents.
behavior.cancellation: Destructor unregisters ClientManager listener; pending delayed-event cancellation behavior is controlled by DelayedEvents destruction/clear paths and should be runtime characterized. No public cancellation method is declared.
persistence: History read/log paths use LogManager; persistent file format/read-tail semantics are owned by LogManager.
resources: PrivateChat owns MessageCache and retains HintedUser shared user; UserConnection is a raw observer/listener pointer and is unregistered by lifecycle paths. DelayedEvents is a member.

PrivateMessage is emitted synchronously under PrivateChatManager::cs write lock on an existing-chat inbound PM (PrivateChatManager.cpp:168-174; PrivateChat.cpp:195-210). Close is emitted synchronously under that same manager write lock when removeChat calls close before erasure (PrivateChatManager.cpp:91-109; PrivateChat.cpp:244-255). SharedMutex is std::shared_mutex (CriticalSection.h:34-36). Those callback paths must not synchronously re-enter manager methods that take cs; copy callback payload and defer such work until return.
records.proposed_bridge_requirement: Callbacks are synchronous on the emitter thread. Copy borrowed payloads promptly. In the PrivateMessage and removeChat Close paths, do not call manager methods that acquire the shared mutex from inside the callback; schedule that work after callback return.
